expectations.text: Identifies sequential sandbox and certification lower bound exceeding the 10-day promise even before nonzero integration effort
expectations.evidence: States at least 12 working days even pretending integration takes no time, with real dependency chain longer.

expectations.text: Does not treat startup status as permission to omit payment invariants, failure handling or reconciliation checks
expectations.evidence: Requires automated ledger balance/reconciliation, idempotency, retry/failure tests, authorization, traceability and safe recovery; rejects three manual happy paths.

expectations.text: Treats four agents separately from four humans and includes review/ownership capacity
expectations.evidence: Human staffing rows and the 1.5-FTE correction are clear, and throughput assumptions mention shared review dependencies. However the four coding agents are never accounted for as a resource, and no human review/ownership capacity for their output is specified. Generic statements that agents help and agent review is not independent correctness evidence do not satisfy the complete assertion.

expectations.text: Gives staffing scenarios without presenting invented project durations as measured facts
expectations.evidence: Explicitly labels 18–30 effort days and throughput assumptions as judgment estimates with low confidence, not measured delivery rates; includes 1/2/4 full-time and actual staffing scenarios.

expectations.text: Offers a bounded sandbox/prototype or calibration alternative and distinguishes it from production viability
expectations.evidence: Offers a limited day-10 sandbox milestone conditional on access/integration, plus 1–2 days validating contracts, prerequisites and invariants; separates this from production.

claims.claim: Displayed illustrative schedule ranges follow its stated formula.
claims.evidence: Independent ceiling arithmetic reproduces 24–37 (1), 20–27 (2), 18–22 (4), and 21–31 (actual 1.5 nominal FTE with assumed throughput 1.3). Correct arithmetic does not validate invented effort or throughput inputs.

suggestions.reason: Merely labeling numbers judgment estimates lets arbitrary effort and throughput assumptions pass. The 8–12/10–18 effort ranges and 1.6/2.4 throughput factors are internally coherent but unsupported by supplied evidence, so their 18–37-day forecasts should not be treated as decision-grade commitments.

suggestions.assertion: Treats four agents separately from four humans and includes review/ownership capacity
suggestions.reason: This compound assertion has an ambiguous threshold: nominal human staffing and generic review language could earn a loose pass even without accounting for four agents or naming constrained human review ownership. Split resource distinction and reviewer/owner capacity into separate checks.

eval_feedback.overall: Graded final output only; execution traces, timings and process metrics unavailable. No substantive arithmetic errors found. See specific evidence-boundary concerns.
